movelist.name: Slam
movelist.effect: Slam may be used as a Free Action at the end of a Sprint Maneuver taken as a Standard Action, as long as the user Shifted at least 3 meters in a straight line towards the target. When used this way, Slam gains the Smite keyword.

movelist.name: Coil
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage, raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage, and the user gains +1 Accuracy.

movelist.name: Bug Bite
movelist.effect: If the target has a stored Digestion Buff or has traded in a Digestion Buff this Scene, the user may gain the effects of the Digestion Buff. This does not count towards the usual limit on the user’s Digestion Buffs.

movelist.name: Flame Wheel
movelist.effect: Flame Wheel Burns the target on 19+.

movelist.name: Wrap
movelist.effect: The user gains a +1 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers, and +2 to Skill Checks made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers or gain Dominance. Whenever the user gains Dominance in a Grapple, the target of the Grapple loses a Tick of Hit Points.

abilities.name: Magma Armor
abilities.effect: Whenever a foe hits you with a Melee Attack or ends their turn grappling you, they lose a tick of Hit Points. Foes immune to Burn do not suffer this effect.

abilities.name: White Smoke
abilities.effect: The user’s Combat Stages, Evasion, or Accuracy may not be lowered except by the user’s own Moves and effects. Defensive.
